title: How to import Templates
text:
* Go to Wikipedia's Special:Export page and enter the full page names of the template you want to import to metakgp. This is download the template as a xml file.
* Go to Special:Import and upload the xml downloaded in the previous step.

How to import Templates

* Go to Wikipedia's Special:Export page and enter the full page names of the template you want to import to metakgp. This is download the template as a xml file.
* Go to Special:Import and upload the xml downloaded in the previous step.
